findings.title: Empty state no longer suppresses tab content
findings.detail: When state is empty, the page renders SurfaceState and still renders the selected tab panel. The baseline gated all PipelineTab, RunTab, and DevicesTab panels behind state !== empty, so an empty response now exposes empty controls (including pairing/task forms) instead of the required empty-only branch.

residual_risks: Static review only; no browser, device, or release proof was run.
The module stylesheet retains unused legacy selectors, but this was not treated as a scope failure.
